content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Rockford

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's credential requirements to confirm you meet the prerequisites. Gather records of your project work, roles, and hours managed. Granite PM Academy staff can clarify eligibility questions before you enroll.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Hours of Formal Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP prep course. Attend synchronous sessions from anywhere, on a schedule that fits your Rockford-area job. Our active certified practitioners deliver the full PMI-mandated curriculum. Upon completion, you'll receive your official course attendance certificate.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: Create your PMI account and complete the PMP application online. Document your project-management experience and education. Pay the PMI exam fee. PMI will review and approve your application before you can schedule your exam with Pearson VUE.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for Your Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice exams, study guides, and instructor office hours—to reinforce course content. Schedule your exam when ready. The computer-based test is administered at Pearson VUE testing centers. You'll receive your pass/fail result immediately after completion.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, you must earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) over a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. PMI accepts PDUs from training, conferences, volunteer work, and published articles. Plan your continuing education early to ensure timely renewal and sustained career credibility.

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
